description: Turns any audio input into a pulse wave whose width you set and modulate, by comparing the input against a threshold or by subtracting a delayed copy of it from itself

params.text: Sets the pulse width, from 0.01 to 0.99 of a cycle; 0.5 gives a square wave with odd harmonics only, and moving away from it brings in even harmonics
Sets the frequency of the internal LFO that modulates the width, from 0.1Hz to 20Hz; with a cable in PWM CV the LFO is not used and this knob changes nothing you can hear
Scales how far the width is modulated, by the internal LFO when PWM CV is empty and by the PWM CV voltage when it is patched; the swing is proportional to the PULSE WIDTH setting
Crossfades between the dry input and the pulse; at 100% only the pulse is heard

inputs.text: The audio input that is turned into a pulse wave
Tracks the pitch of the input so the delay stays the same fraction of a cycle at every note; in comparator mode nothing in the output depends on it
Modulates the pulse width and replaces the internal LFO for as long as a cable is in it; ±5V gives the full swing set by PWM DEPTH

outputs.text: The pulse, crossfaded with the dry input by MIX, at as many channels as the wider of IN and V/OCT

notes: the module comes up in comparator mode, and delay mode is chosen from the panel menu
in delay mode patch V/OCT, or the delay is computed as though the input were C4 at 261.63Hz and the width will be wrong at every other pitch
the width is clamped to between 0.01 and 0.99 of a cycle, so neither the knob nor the modulation can close the pulse completely
menu: Comparator Mode — the output swings to 5V whenever the input is above a threshold set by PULSE WIDTH and to -5V otherwise, which works with any input and needs no V/OCT
Delay Mode — subtracts a delayed copy of the input from itself, the delay being the pulse width as a fraction of one cycle, which suits sawtooth inputs and keeps more of the input's character

inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V, which is C4.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the internal LFO.
